Do you have a desire to stop drinking? This is a place to ask questions or to share some experience, strength, and hope.

I just celebrated 3 years free from alcohol after trying to quit for over 30 years and have tried just about every method there is for staying sober. I have found that using a variety of support groups is essential for prolonged success.

Welcome!

Congratulations on your sobriety! I never really had a problem, so to speak, with alcohol dependency. I did however used to binge drink about three or four nights a week, and I found substituting marijuana for alcohol to be a lot less destructive and easier to function after. Now I smoke irregularly and rarely drink so I guess it worked out alright!

Sounds like you found a good happy medium to balance things out. I was a binge drinker also, but my binges lasted months at a time and the last one ended with a dui so I finally got fed up with the consequences and gave up alcohol completely. Best decision ever!

Thanks for the welcome. Happy to see that I can have a new home if Reddit ends up going Digg.

360 days sober today, happy to be almost at my one year. Pretty bummed about the situation at Reddit, as the sub over there has been a huge support for me.

Any chance you can set a badge up for users for days of sobriety? I used reddit's to track my progress on those trying days.
